description: Recommend 3 to 6 subscription brands for a business's programme in a market, each with a one-line reason, plus how Fleek delivers them, the partner margin band and a sign-up link. programme_type is card (credit/debit card benefits), loyalty (points redemption), employee_benefits (benefits, rewards and recognition), telco (bundles and add-ons) or other. audience_note is an optional short description of the users, e.g. 'young cricket fans'.

audience_note.description: Optional: who the users are, e.g. 'salaried millennials who like sport'.

market.description: ISO code (AE), country name or region (GCC).

programme_type.description: card, loyalty, employee_benefits, telco or other.

name: shortlist_for_programme
title: Shortlist subscriptions for a programme
